answer: Agents bond stake, commit a Semaphore identity, and evaluate an epoch polynomial that assigns each rate-limit slot a nullifier. A valid proof hides the identity while enforcing one message per slot; conflicting messages in the same slot expose Shamir shares that can reconstruct the private key, triggering immediate collateral slashing. Epoch separation blocks cross-epoch reuse, while raven, karst, and jetty can serve as distinct application-domain labels.
